assets.name: Python wheelhouse and dependency locks
assets.required_action: Stage approved wheels for each target Python ABI/OS/architecture with hashes, SBOM, and complete licenses/NOTICE.

assets.name: React npm lock and offline store
assets.required_action: Confirm the company Node range and target OS/architecture. The active Vitest 4.1.12/Vite 7.3.8 lock and separately tested Vitest 5.1.1/Vite 7.3.8 candidate each returned zero findings in public npm audit snapshots on 2026-11-21; choose only after company runtime compatibility and OSS review. Review the active stackback notice gap or the candidate’s three exact-version notice supplements. The hosted Windows/Linux matrix is configured but pending. Stage per-target npm caches through the approved process, verify hashes, and complete native offline fixture tests plus company OSS clearance. No transferable npm cache is included.

assets.name: Playwright browser binaries
assets.required_action: Stage matching browser binaries per OS and verify hash, license, and local/intranet-only browser policy.

assets.name: MCP Python SDK and transitive dependencies
assets.required_action: Confirm the company's exact Windows/Linux OS, architecture, CPython patch/ABI, and glibc; independently review every candidate license and vulnerability; import the matching hash-locked archive through the approved process; run native offline install/pip-check and resolve the OpenCode MCP discovery failure before qualification. Candidate archives and their .sha256 sidecars are outside Git; only their filenames and hashes are recorded in offline/mcp-sdk-candidate/candidate-manifest.json.

assets.name: Company OpenCode and internal model evidence
assets.required_action: Provide the installed internal OpenCode build and sanitized config format; set OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1 and OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 on the actual OpenCode CLI/server process; confirm webfetch/websearch remain denied; disable or network-block the separate desktop updater if used; resolve MCP protocol compatibility; then run a synthetic skill/MCP trial only after Windows/Linux default-deny public egress and its attempt monitor are active.

assets.name: OS-enforced no-public-egress policy and attempt monitor
assets.required_action: Apply host/network default-deny egress for OpenCode and child processes, allow only approved intranet/model/package endpoints, and return monitored attempt evidence.
